necessary_context.content: Finite-dimensional Euclidean Z. Equation (1): find z* with <F(z*),z-z*>+g(z)-g(z*)>=0 for every z. Sol nonempty; g proper convex lower semicontinuous; F:dom g→Z monotone. Unbiased oracle Fξ satisfies E||Fξ(u)-Fξ(v)||²<=L²||u-v||²; Assumption 1 prints the quantifier for all u,v∈Z although F is introduced on dom g. Algorithm requires exact prox and exact snapshot F.
necessary_context.name: Euclidean VI and Assumption 1

necessary_context.content: Section 2.3.1 prints Gap(w)=max_{z∈C}{<F(z),w-z>+g(w)-g(z)}, with C compact. Theorem 4 uses z^K=K^{-1}Σ_{k=0}^{K-1}z_{k+1/2}. This is a restricted comparison metric, not an unrestricted residual or a last-iterate guarantee. Domain interpretation and the relation of C to Sol require clarification before promoting the repaired Theorem.
necessary_context.name: Restricted Gap and averaging
